ops.title: In-repo docs-speed delivery: wrapper patches + cc-guides yml kind
ops.description: Execute the approved plan (plans/docs-spe-elegant-seal): ship the loader-fix as a version-gated wrapper patch (docs/scripts/build_docs.py), probe Quarto 1.10 + patch strategies against stock PyPI great-docs 0.15.0, pilot on cc-transcript, add a .yml renderable kind to cc-guides and fragment-ize great-docs.yml/docs.yml, write the decision matrix to cc-notes, roll out to captain-hook + cc-steer + repo-bootstrap templates. Constraints: nothing public toward posit-dev/great-docs (no pushes/PRs/issues; clone branch stays local at 72a998e); captain-hook's custom docs.yml is hand-edited, never re-scaffolded; patches fail loud and fall back to stock. Prior evidence: cc-notes note f81e978 (decision package), log 5ef7aa3 (perf gates).
